extracted.intended_audience: public relations and communications professionals (agency owners, corporate communicators, nonprofit communicators, students, professors, solopreneurs) seeking PESO Model training or certification
extracted.subtask_description: A professional certification and training program teaching communicators how to correctly and effectively implement the PESO Model, combined with ethics and practical skills to build integrated communications programs. Delivered as online training, coaching, and education in partnership with an academic institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct and effective implementation of the PESO Model
rubrics_metrics.description: Communicators who have learned how to correctly and effectively implement the PESO Model, a framework we developed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Spin Sucks Academy provides online training, coaching, and rigorous and forward-thinking education so PESO Model Certified communicators are trained to lead the industry and build and scale integrated communications programs for organizations of all kinds. (Page emphasizes partnership with the S.I. Newhouse School for Public Communications as part of the certification.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical practice / adherence to the Golden Rule
rubrics_metrics.description: We are ethical. We are upstanding. We live the Golden Rule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site contrasts ethical practitioners with 'spin doctors' and those who lie or create fake news, stating that communicators who 'believe that spin does suck abide by a code of ethics and live by the Golden Rule.' Ethical conduct is presented as a core qualification for trustworthy communicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrable impact on organizational goals (PR as investment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prove the work we do can affect the goals of an organization—and finally prove the work we do is an investment, not an expense.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A central objective of Spin Sucks and its training is to change perception of PR by demonstrating measurable value and contribution to organizational outcomes; certification/education should enable practitioners to make that case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to build and scale integrated communications programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Build and scale integrated communications programs for organizations of all kinds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PESO Model Certified communicators are explicitly described as being trained to lead and to build/scale integrated programs—implying competence across paid, earned, shared, and owned media and program-level strategy and execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous, forward-thinking professional development
rubrics_metrics.description: Online training, coaching, and rigorous and forward-thinking education for communicators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Academy's approach emphasizes rigorous instruction and coaching; the page cites a history of professional development (working with hundreds of agency owners, corporate communicators, nonprofit specialists, students, professors, solopreneurs, and business leaders) as evidence of the program's scope and practicality.
